summary: Register lists a steel lookout on Bear Hill used 1919-1926; a 2011 blog describes a standing concrete tower there, and the two accounts do not match.

facts.design: 70-foot steel tower (register); the 2011 blog describes a reinforced concrete tower beside a working water holder
facts.status_note: Register says the steel tower was no longer used after 1926; a 2011 blog describes a standing concrete tower on Bear Hill. Not confirmed whether they are the same structure

access.note: Bear Hill is in the Middlesex Fells reservation, which has trails; the current sources do not say whether the concrete tower is open to climbers

visit.trail_note: In 2011 the writer walked a few minutes uphill from a parking lot to reach the tower

events.note: Blog, citing Friends of the Fells: a wooden observation tower was replaced by a reinforced concrete tower in the year an electric trolley station opened at Sheepfold

corrections.why: Register describes a 70-foot steel tower on Bear Hill
Register says only that the steel tower was no longer used after 1926; a 2011 blog describes a standing concrete tower on Bear Hill, so 'gone' is not supported for the site

sources.title: The Reversed View of Massachusetts: Bear Hill Tower, Stoneham
sources.publisher: The Reversed View of Massachusetts (blog, May 22, 2011)

notes_for_editor: The register's steel lookout (1919-1926) and the blog's standing concrete tower (replacing a wooden tower in 1910) may or may not be the same site; no source resolves it. The 1910 history is the blog's, attributed to the Friends of the Fells. fells.org history page returned 404 and the Friends of the Fells history page has no tower text, so the claim is unverified. Blog is a single 2011 visit and the only source describing the standing tower; its leisure-purpose remark is the writer's guess. Dave's Photo Blog essay was unreachable. The register's coordinates (42.46567, -71.1065) were not checked against the blog's location. Brief status 'gone' was changed to unknown in corrections and kind 'unknown' to tower. No staffing source was found.
